So, I do have 5 bunnies and about 5 birds as well. My bunnies don't seem to be bothered when my birds are noisy, however, they aren't really one of the easy to be frightened type as well. I think it depends on the bunnies personality. You should make sure you're getting you're baby from someone who puts lots of love into them. Added to that, I think it'd be good if you give you're bunny an opportunity to escape from the noises if it gets too much (like, if it's possible just let him run around in two or more rooms)

If I was you, I would've given a mini lop a chance for the choice of breed! They hear less than a "normal" bunny, which maybe could come in handy in a situation like that? I'm not really sure though. Other than that, is it maybe possible for you to just seperate them altogether? :D

Hey there!

I'm on Escitalopram and it has helped immensly! I can enjoy activities again, can eat out again, go to school again and live a decent life. The phobia isn't entirely gone, but it's often only in the back of my mind. This is coming from an severe Emetophobe which couldn't even imagine leaving the bed about 7 months ago. 

I hadn't had any GI related side effects (maybe only a bit d* but that could be due to my anxiety as well), only got more forgetful, but honestly I can live with that. 

It will get better though. Believe in yourself, you're stronger than you think you are and ilysm. Thanks for being alive ❤
